description: Lists the messages the GoCertius bot recorded in one chat, so you can pick the range to certify. Requires: case_file_create → caseFileId and chat_list or chat_create → chatId. Optional filters: filter.writtenFrom and filter.writtenTo (ISO 8601 date-time); order.writtenAt sorts ASC or DESC; page.number and page.size (up to 100) paginate. Returns { data, meta }. Then call chat_certificate_create with chatMessagesFrom at or after the chat's registeredAt (see chat_get).
name: chat_message_list
